releases.notes:
- Beta: please report problems from About > Report a bug
- A whole new look in four themes (Neon, Studio, You, System); Stories get their own tab
- Search every setting from Home and flip it right there; round shortcuts
- Dynamic stop the addiction: always on, the feed calms down the longer you scroll
- Home shows your day; watch history of every video you scroll to
- Watch button and tap-to-open: recorded streams and followed channels open in TikTok
- Story archive as a grid; a notification when a story is deleted; search in downloads
- Works on TikTok 47.9.2

- Beta: please report problems from About > Report a bug
- Stories: download without a watermark; an archive of every story you watch, deleted ones kept and marked 🗑
- Auto-save the stories of chosen channels
- Watch stories anonymously and hide your profile visits
- Also includes 4.8.0: private accounts' LIVEs auto-recorded, stop each recording on its own, quality per channel, Report a bug
- Works on TikTok 47.9.2

- Stop the addiction: choose how much of your feed shouldn't hook you (0-100%), at once or gradually; learns from what you watch
- Ads inserted on the phone removed too
- Progress bar on every video; no more robot checks in LIVE
- Works on TikTok 47.9.2

- The live chat burned into your LIVE recordings, timed like in TikTok
- Gifts as banners, and their full-screen animations played in the video
- One synced notification per recording; a stopped recording stays stopped
- Fixed: live chat recording saved nothing; now reliable, one transcript per stream in Download/TikMod

- 10 general updates: feed filters, playback speed, mute, keep screen on, no vibration, external links
- Progress bar on every video (setting)
- Also includes live captions with translation and live chat recording
- Works on TikTok 47.9.1

- Live captions with translation over any LIVE stream
- Quick menu on the stream: languages, text size, transcript
- LIVE history works now
- Update checks no longer depend on GitHub's rate-limited API

- Recordings continue into the same file after a restart
- Fixed repeated human-verification prompts in LIVE and failing subscriptions

- LIVE history
- "Active now" hidden at the HTTP layer
- Optional: don't report views

- 10 languages
- Record now and parallel recordings
- In-app updates
